notes.title: Grenades, Mines and duels!
notes.notes:
Grenades and Mines have been added back in!

New 1 VS 1 Duel mode! Ranked and leaderboards coming soon

notes.title: The beginning has begun
notes.notes:
It's starting to feel pretty good to play! Come check out the new bootcamp map!

Also new armor and new weapons!

notes.title: Jetpack Battle playtest is now open!
notes.notes:
The playtest is now open for all to register!

The CTF Game mode is mostly working, with voting for a new map at the end of the round also functional.

There are 4 classic T1 maps at the moment:

Stonehenge
Raindance
Dangerous Crossing
Canyon Crusade

Inventory stations and multiple armor classes coming very soon! With vehicles following close behind.
